name: Passwordless Login
description: Since Jellyfin 12, GET /Users/Public always reports HasPassword = true, so the web client asks for a password even for accounts that have none. When enabled, this plugin reports HasPassword = false again for users that use the default authentication provider and have no password, but only for requests coming from the local network. Disabled by default: read the security warning on the settings page before enabling it.
overview: Restore one-click login for passwordless users on the local network
